## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits (for example, `fix: handle empty search results`).
- [ ] The pull request is focused and linked to an issue when applicable.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior, and documentation is updated when needed.
- [ ] I ran the relevant lint, format, typecheck, test, and build checks.
- [ ] I have not added skipped or focused tests.
- [ ] Required owner review is requested for repository policy or platform changes.

## Summary

Describe the change and its user or contributor impact.

## Validation

List the checks run and any remaining limitations.
